description: Create a local Convex sales demo for Danielson School and add a dynamic zoomable teacher proficiency graph to teacher reports.
deviation_notes: The browser review found one pre-hydration form safety defect. The final fix added the native POST method and one regression test. The portfolio correction added one observation index and no new table or runtime layer. A later correction added the missing local-only pilot credentials to the login page. One graph correction preserved component rating data. A later user review required visible 1–4 averages and score colors on all rated hierarchy nodes. The final graph uses the existing report projection and adds no stored score or backend read. A later browser review found that the HTML legend swatches used the SVG fill property. This correction changes only the legend CSS property and its regression coverage.
